item.title: Refactor order status into OrderStatus
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate's status representation as requested by the operator. Add src/status.rs with public enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement as_str(self) -> &'static str returning lowercase names, Display with the same names, FromStr with type Err = ParseStatusError, and a public ParseStatusError implementing std::error::Error whose message names the rejected input. Implement can_transition_to(self, next) with exactly: Pending -> Paid, Pending -> Cancelled, Paid -> Shipped, Paid -> Cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use the enum everywhere so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior exactly, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing. Run cargo test and ensure it passes. Commit the work locally. Acceptance: implementation meets the listed API and lifecycle; all status name literals are confined to src/status.rs; cargo test passes; commit exists on the item's branch.
